summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) of the CipherBox project using the GSD workflow system, then run the full autonomous ship pipeline: verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E → CodeRabbit → ship → resolve PR reviews.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves), executed, and verified (7/7 must-haves, HARD-09 satisfied). The ship pipeline reached the Nyquist validation gate with security audit (19/19 threats closed), SDK E2E (89/89 passing), 4 code-review findings applied, and 2 deferred todos captured. The transcript ends before PR creation.

repo: TEST_LOGIN_SECRET in apps/api/.env is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only', but the SDK E2E default SDK_E2E_SECRET is 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production' — a mismatch causes silent 401s that make the entire suite appear skipped rather than failed.
vitest 3 does not auto-load tests/sdk-e2e/.env; the secret must be explicitly passed via SDK_E2E_SECRET env var on the command line.
crates/fuse cannot dev-depend on api-client/core due to a circular dependency; cross-language vector test consumers must live in crates/fuse/tests/, not crates/crypto/tests/.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL restrictions; PR body must be patched via 'env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file'.
github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit to the branch after PR creation and after a passing Release Preview — git fetch + rebase is required before any subsequent push.
The commit helper reports commit_failed while the commit actually lands; always verify with 'git log --oneline -1' rather than retrying.
phase.complete warns about 5 pre-existing REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) missing from the traceability table — these are pre-existing hygiene gaps unrelated to HARD-09.
6 unverified resolve_ipns call sites exist in apps/desktop/src-tauri/ (prepopulate.rs, vault.rs) — explicitly deferred in 58-01, no regression from baseline.
markdownlint excludes .planning/ on commit, but prettier still runs there.

GSD executor commits use a non-conventional 'feat 51-03:' style that fails Release Please CI; must reword before the first push using git filter-branch --msg-filter (git rebase -i is unavailable in this environment).
D-09 gate (upsertFolderIpns): the idempotent TEE re-sign path must not increment the DB sequence number, but must still update latestCid.

code.finding: Adding a temporary axios response interceptor logging err.response.data is the correct technique to surface real 400 error reasons from the API, since the API does not log handled 4xx by default.
Contains TEST_LOGIN_SECRET and THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET; the SDK E2E suite must be invoked with these values extracted via grep rather than using hardcoded defaults.
New module introduced as the IPNS verification chokepoint; imports ciborium which must be listed as a dependency of the fuse crate (not just core) for the build to succeed.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch (rather than parallel worktrees) is the safer choice for multi-crate crypto phases where merge conflicts and cwd-drift are high-risk.
When a subagent crashes mid-task due to an API socket error, check git state (git log, git diff) before spawning a continuation — partial commits may have already landed and must not be re-applied.
A subagent spawned for one plan may complete multiple plans opportunistically (58-02 executor also completed 58-03); this is harmless when plans are sequential but requires careful state tracking.

SDK E2E suite skipping silently (no failures, just 0 tests run) is a symptom of a secret mismatch or auth failure, not an infra outage — never accept 'infra-limited' without confirming the auth flow works.
Commit history reword must happen after all doc/artifact commits land on the branch but before the first push; rewording during an in-flight agent commit race risks losing commits.
For verified crypto code immediately before ship, defer all marginal simplifications to a todo rather than churning audited code — operating rule: risky/large/marginal → defer with file refs.
Running the phase verifier and advisory code reviewer in parallel is safe and efficient since both are read-only analysis of the same artifact set.

The 'fix commit scope mislabeled' pattern (e.g., fix(58-03) touching a 58-01 file) is a known fixer artifact — cosmetic only if the actual file edits are correct and tests pass; not worth rewriting history.
Post-plan gap analysis and requirements/decision coverage gates should run immediately after all plans are committed, before spawning the verifier, to surface scope gaps cheaply.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task due to an API socket close after committing 3 of 5 tasks, leaving uncommitted FUSE routing changes and requiring a manual continuation agent.

SDK E2E was initially misclassified as 'infra-limited' by the executor due to a TEST_LOGIN_SECRET/SDK_E2E_SECRET mismatch that caused silent 401s, requiring a separate dedicated agent to run the gate correctly.
One executor spawned for 58-02 autonomously completed 58-03 as well, making wave-tracking and checkpoint accounting ambiguous mid-run.
The commit helper false-negative (reporting commit_failed on success) required verification via git log after every commit operation.
gh pr edit is broken on this repo, requiring a less ergonomic gh api PATCH workaround for PR body updates.
Fix commits from the code-fixer had mislabeled scopes (e.g., fix(58-03) touching a 58-01 file) — cosmetic but confusing in git history.
git push and git fetch are blocked in the sandbox environment, requiring explicit sandbox-disable for push operations.
The test-login payload shape was not immediately obvious, making it impossible to probe :3000 directly to diagnose the secret mismatch without reading the harness first.
